python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,mmap,os,struct
p=lambda s:pathlib.Path(s)
vp=p('store/jobs/j000109/out/version-strings.txt'); vtxt=vp.read_text(errors='replace')
kdbx=p('store/jobs/j000078/out/file.0xab0b138c5bc0.0xab0b0d5e4230.DataSectionObject.bruce.kdbx.dat').read_bytes()
match_raw=p('store/jobs/j000105/out/match.json').read_text(errors='replace'); match=json.loads(match_raw)
entries_raw=p('store/jobs/j000107/out/entries.json').read_text(errors='replace'); entries=json.loads(entries_raw)
cmp_raw=p('store/jobs/j000179/out/keepass-source-compare.json').read_text(errors='replace'); cmp=json.loads(cmp_raw)
digest='31095c0a1a117a374baa7d172ae1fd1f'
# recursively count exact digest without emitting any other string values
def count_obj(o,target):
 if isinstance(o,dict): return sum(count_obj(k,target)+count_obj(v,target) for k,v in o.items())
 if isinstance(o,list): return sum(count_obj(x,target) for x in o)
 return int(isinstance(o,str) and o.lower()==target)
raw=p('inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw')
with raw.open('rb') as f:
 m=mmap.mmap(f.fileno(),0,access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
 ro={s:{'ascii':m.find(s.encode()),'utf16le':m.find(s.encode('utf-16le'))} for s in ['KeePass Password Safe 2','2.53.1']}
 m.close()
out={
 'declared_objects_read':6,
 'raw_size':raw.stat().st_size,
 'raw_version_literal_offsets':ro,
 'resource_product_present':'KeePass Password Safe 2' in vtxt,
 'resource_version_present':'2.53.1' in vtxt,
 'kdbx_size':len(kdbx),
 'kdbx_signature_hex':kdbx[:8].hex(),
 'match_json_type':type(match).__name__,
 'match_digest_exact_occurrences':count_obj(match,digest),
 'entries_json_type':type(entries).__name__,
 'entries_digest_exact_occurrences':count_obj(entries,digest),
 'compare_json_type':type(cmp).__name__,
 'compare_digest_exact_occurrences':count_obj(cmp,digest),
 'digest_consistent_across_match_entries_compare':all(count_obj(x,digest)>0 for x in [match,entries,cmp]),
 'note':'No password plaintext or Q4 credential field is emitted.'
}
path=pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT'])/'q3-full-provenance-check.json'; path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
PY
